category.reason: The minimum-price slider handle controls the lower bound of the price filter.

instruction.en: Locate the current position of the minimum-price slider in the price filter.
instruction.zh: 定位价格筛选器最低价滑块的当前位置。

reference.patch: Added instruction.zh by translating the revised English instruction. The original instruction identified the target as the leftmost price slider. Revised the instruction to identify the minimum-price slider in the price filter, making its role explicit. Shifted groundTruth from [537.0, 544.0, 625.0, 460.0] to [524.0, 536.0, 612.0, 452.0] in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates, centering the existing-size box on the minimum-price handle. Updated category.reason to explain the minimum-price handle’s role in the price filter. Changed category.item from Small Target to Functional.
